answer_1.quote: Definition 1 (RE-semantic). Given an image of table T and a pair of columns (c i , c j ) in T , a model M with given candidate relation set R predicts a relation r ij ∈ R that best describes the semantic relationship between c i and c j . Definition 2 (RE-calculational). Given an image of table T containing a set of columns (c 1 , c 2 , ..., c n ), a model M forms a calculation expression E p,q,...,m with math operators and takes column headers as operands, which describes the calculational relation between numerical columns c p , c q , ..., c m .
answer_1.outputs: Relation types for semantic relation extraction and calculation expressions for calculational relation extraction.

answer_2.quote: For semantic RE task with a candidate relation set, we adopt Micro-F1 which is suitable for multi-classification tasks. For the calculational RE which requires exact matching of expressions, we use Accuracy for evaluation.

answer_4.quote: And for precise evaluation of the calculation expression, we combine rule-based Python scripts and manual methods to address the issue that exact match cannot identify equivalent expressions with different formulations.
